d: The Wizards defeated the Magic, 116-96 tonight in Washington. Kyshawn George contributed a team-high 24 points to go with 6 three pointers 4 assists and 3 rebounds, with Anthony Davis of the Wizards adding an additional 22 points (8-13 FG, 2-5 3P) in the game. Tristan da Silva finished with a team-high 18 points along with 4 three pointers for the Magic in the losing effort. The Wizards improve their record to 7-11 with the win, while the Magic fall to 7-9 for the season.
